title: 第15章 魔王左手第16章 这梁子算结下了
slug: 邪鼎第3739章本祖是她的师尊
content_zh:
回到洞府。
“赔偿的五枚聚气丹，全落到许三阴手里。”
“赢来的灵石，也全给了冷月。”
“连答应给你的奖励，也作废？”
“亲爱的小凡凡，我想问你一句，费了这么大的劲，你捞到了什么？”
大黑狗听完苏凡的讲述，倍感无语。
别说好处，连这小子心心念念的裸·奔，都没看到。
“眼光要长远。”
“不要计较眼前这点蝇头小利。”
“只要能在流云宗扎根，只要许三阴不再害我，以后想要什么没有？”
苏凡呲牙。
大黑狗一愣，怪笑道：“不错嘛，都开始教我做事。”
“哪敢哪敢。”
苏凡讪讪一笑，问道：“狗哥，气血珠还有吗？”
“没有。”
“有也不给你。”
“让你喜欢当烂好人。”
大黑狗冷哼。
苏凡憋着嘴，说道：“我给大师姐气血珠，也是为今后做打算。”
“我看你就是在讨好未来的媳妇才对吧！”

大黑狗直翻白眼，苦口婆心道：“小子，给你一句忠告，女人是祸水，只会影响你打·枪的速度。”
“自己打·枪多没劲。”
苏凡摇头，从储物袋里取出魔王鼎，皱眉道：“狗哥，我觉得，魔王鼎放我身上，始终不太安全。”
这次无疑就是一个教训。
要不是大师姐帮忙，魔王鼎肯定保不住。
“确实。”
大黑狗点头，寻思道：“要不这样吧，先给我保管，等你需要的时候，我再给你。”
“你藏在哪？”
苏凡狐疑。
“气海。”
大黑狗说道。
苏凡愣了下。
气海是什么地方？
“修炼第一境界是脱胎，第二境界是拓脉，第三个境界是汇海。”
“到达汇海期，可开辟出气海，到时灵气将汇聚于气海，慢慢凝练成灵力。”
“气海也就在你小腹之内，等开辟出来，便可将重要的东西，放置于气海。”
大黑狗解释。
苏凡捞起衣服，看着平坦的小腹，眼中充满好奇。
意思就是，等他开辟出气海，就可以把魔王鼎藏在里面？
“灵力是由灵气浓缩而成，因此杀伤力比灵气更强，不过对你来说，开辟气海太遥远。”

大黑狗轻轻一碰魔王鼎，魔王鼎就瞬间消失无影。
“早晚的事。”
苏凡放下衣服，信心满满的拍着小腹。
有魔王鼎在，别说拓脉期，汇海期，更高的境界也难不住他。
突然。
content_en:
Return to the cave.
"The five Qi Gathering Pills compensated all fell into Xu Sanyin's hands."
"All the spirit stones I won were given to Leng Yue."
"Even the reward promised to you is invalid?"
"Dear Xiao Fanfan, I want to ask you, what did you get after spending so much effort?"
The big black dog was speechless after listening to Su Fan's story.
Not to mention the benefits, I didn't even see the kid running around naked.
“Take a long-term view.”
"Don't care about the little profit you have right now."
"As long as I can take root in Liuyun Sect, and as long as Xu Sanyin no longer harms me, is there anything I want in the future?"
Su Fan bared his teeth.
The big black dog was stunned and said with a strange smile: "Not bad, they started teaching me how to do things."
"How dare you?"
Su Fan smiled and asked, "Brother Dog, do you still have the Qi and Blood Beads?"
"No."
"I won't give it to you even if I have it."
"Make you like being a bad guy."
The big black dog snorted coldly.
Su Fan held his tongue and said, "I gave the Qi and Blood Beads to Senior Sister to make plans for the future."
"I think you are just trying to please your future wife!"
The big black dog rolled his eyes and said earnestly: "Boy, let me give you a piece of advice. Women are a nuisance. They will only affect your shooting speed."
"It's so boring to shoot a gun yourself."
Su Fan shook his head, took out the Demon King's Cauldron from his storage bag, frowned and said, "Brother Dog, I feel that it is not safe for the Demon King's Cauldron to be placed on me."
This time is undoubtedly a lesson.
If it weren't for the help of Senior Sister, the Demon King's Cauldron would definitely not be saved.
"Indeed."
The big black dog nodded and thought: "How about this, keep it for me first, and I will give it to you when you need it."
"Where are you hiding?"
Su Fan was suspicious.
"The sea of ​​air."
The big black dog said.
Su Fan was stunned for a moment.
Where is Qihai?
"The first level of cultivation is to reborn, the second level is to expand the pulse, and the third level is to merge into the sea."
"When you reach the Sea of Convergence stage, you can open up a sea of ​​qi. At that time, the spiritual energy will gather in the sea of ​​qi and slowly condense into spiritual power."
"The sea of ​​qi is also within your lower abdomen. Once it is opened, important things can be placed in the sea of ​​qi."
The big black dog explained.
Su Fan picked up his clothes and looked at his flat belly, his eyes full of curiosity.
Does this mean that when he opens up the Qi Sea, he can hide the Demon King's Cauldron inside?
"Spiritual power is concentrated from spiritual energy, so it is more lethal than spiritual energy, but for you, opening up the sea of ​​qi is too far away."
As soon as the big black dog touched the Devil's Cauldron, the Devil's Cauldron disappeared instantly.
"Sooner or later."
Su Fan put down his clothes and patted his belly confidently.
With the Demon King's Cauldron around, let alone the Pulse Extension Stage, the Sea Convergence Stage, and even higher realms would not be difficult for him.
Sudden.
